summary: Tested new Beneficiary Alias feature end-to-end. Backend: 15/15 pytest passed including new TestSupplierAlias (seeded suppliers expose expected aliases 'Baja Makmur'/'Karya Logam'/'Mitra Kimia'/'Prima Plastik'; POST /api/suppliers with alias creates+returns alias; PUT updates alias) plus all prior regression suites (Suppliers CRUD, delete-blocked-when-tx-exists, denorm sync, Transactions CRUD, Sender Accounts CRUD+sync, Settings, Recommendations, SupplierNotFound bug regression). Frontend Playwright: (1) '+ Catat Transfer' -> supplier-select-dropdown opens Popover, supplier-search-input filter: typing 'kimia' filters to exactly 1 option 'PT Mitra Kimia Nusantara (Supplier C)'; typing 'baja' filters to exactly 1 option 'PT Sumber Baja Makmur (Supplier A)'. Selecting supplier-option closes popover and sets trigger text. Full submit with sender + amount 2.500.000 + date 2026-09-20 -> 200 + toast 'Transfer berhasil dicatat' (no 'Supplier tidak ditemukan'). (2) 'Kelola Supplier' -> supplier-alias-input present; adding TEST_UI_AliasSup with alias TESTUIA renders alias badge in row; edit prefills alias input value 'TESTUIA'; updating to TESTUIA2 saves and reflects new badge; delete works.

issues: react-error-overlay surfaces benign 'ResizeObserver loop completed with undelivered notifications' warning; blocks clicks until dismissed. Suggest suppressing this specific noise via window.addEventListener('error') filter or CRA config so preview users don't see the red overlay.

action_items: Optional: suppress ResizeObserver loop warning from surfacing in react-error-overlay in preview builds.
critical_code_review_comments: Alias field defaults to '' (Optional[str]='') in both Supplier and SupplierCreate; consistent and safe.
TransactionDialog Command filter uses substring match over combined value `${name} ${alias} ${bank} ${account_number}` — correctly supports partial alias/name/bank/account search.
PUT /api/suppliers correctly re-syncs supplier_name/bank/account_number on denormalized transactions but does not need to sync alias (alias not stored on tx) — acceptable.
Prior comment still applies: PUT /api/transactions/{tx_id} matches even soft-deleted docs by id (the filter is {id, deleted_at: None} on update_one — actually correct; ignore prior note).
seed_data_creation: Re-seeded via POST /api/seed?force=true at end of run to clean up leftover TEST_* suppliers from backend fixtures. Fresh state: 4 seeded suppliers (with aliases), 2 sender accounts, 3 transactions.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Alias feature verified. Combobox supports partial substring search across name+alias+bank+account. data-testids in use: supplier-select-dropdown (trigger), supplier-search-input (CommandInput), supplier-option-<id> (CommandItem), supplier-alias-input (in SupplierManager). Backend has 15 pytest tests in /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (runs ~4s with pytest-xdist).
rca of the issue: N/A - feature verified working as specified.
